title: Next-Business-Day Bank Transfers on the Paystride Earned Wage Access Plan: Amount Schedule and Worker Request
content:
**Paystride Earned Wage Access Plan — next-business-day early wage transfers to the worker's own bank account.**

## Scope of the bank transfer amount schedule

The bank transfer amount schedule sets the bank transfer amount: the amount of a next-business-day transfer to the worker's bank account on a plan whose worker holds no other Earned Wage Access Plan that is not closed and whose employer's program agreement carries a configured access percentage no lower than the bank transfer percentage worked out for that transfer. For such a transfer, and only for such a transfer, it replaces the base rule on the amount available, and every other transfer, the instant debit-card transfers their own schedule governs among them, remains as that schedule or the base rule provides.

## When the amount is worked out

The bank transfer amount is worked out only after the plan's level effective date falls after the pay date of its latest period close line, where it has one, that pay date is before today and no shortfall carries a pay date on or after the level effective date.

Put another way: on a plan whose latest period close carries a pay date before today, and on which no shortfall carries a pay date on or after the level effective date, the amount is not worked out while the level effective date is on or before that pay date.

## The worker's own request: `request_bank_transfer_bc93e4f0`

**Capability.** The worker confirms, in person, a next-business-day early wage transfer from their Earned Wage Access Plan to their own bank account. One call books one transfer entry on the plan for the stated amount, for delivery by ACH on the business day following the request date, a request made past the day's submission cutoff or on a non-business day counting as made on the following business day, carrying the plan's current payday as the payday on which it is recovered, and adds the amount to the plan's outstanding balance. The worker sees the transfer on the plan's history at once; it shows as not yet delivered while the bank credit is unconfirmed. No fee is booked by this action.

**Invocation.** This is the worker's own tool: the agent unlocks `request_bank_transfer_bc93e4f0` and hands it over, and the customer themselves (the worker) runs it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `access_plan_id` | the reference number of the worker's Earned Wage Access Plan, read from the plan record looked up for this worker | identifier text |
| `amount` | the transfer amount the worker confirms | US dollars, a positive figure with 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent if more places are given |
| `daily_sequence` | the ordinal of this transfer among the plan's transfers booked on today's Eastern Time calendar day | an integer of 1 or more |

**Return.** A confirmation sentence carrying the new transfer entry's reference number, the amount booked in US dollars with two decimals, the payday it is recovered on (YYYY-MM-DD), the delivery speed (next business day) and destination (bank account), and the plan's outstanding balance including the transfer in US dollars with two decimals; the reference number's presence means the transfer is booked. Explicit errors: an `amount` that is not a positive dollar figure; a `daily_sequence` that is not an integer of 1 or more; no plan with the given `access_plan_id`. On an error nothing is booked.
